# SPAR — Behavioral Self-Signatures in LLMs

> Can an LLM recognize its own simulated coin-flip sequences, or predict their statistics, better than other models can? Three models, three generation procedures, a frozen 180-sequence corpus, and eight experiments. Main finding: no privileged self-recognition. Attribution follows the stated generation procedure, not the sequence.

Start with the review guide. It gives the reading order, maps claims to evidence, indexes the runs, and lists large files to avoid.
